mapper.select: SELECT items.id, items.name, items.category_id AS categoryId, items.amount, items.purchase_amount AS purchaseAmount, items.deadline, items.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, items.others, items.status, items.favorite_flg AS favorite, categories.name AS categoryName FROM items INNER JOIN categories ON items.category_id = categories.id WHERE items.status <> 0 AND items.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY category_id ASC, deadline ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO items( name, category_id, amount, purchase_amount, deadline, purchase_date, others, status, favorite_flg, user_id ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{purchaseAmount}, #{deadline}, #{purchaseDate}, #{others}, #{status}, #{favorite}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.name, i.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, i.amount, i.deadline, i.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, i.others, i.status, i.favorite_flg AS favorite FROM items i LEFT JOIN categories c ON i.category_id = c.id WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE items SET name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, amount = #{amount}, deadline = #{deadline}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, others = #{others}, favorite_flg = #{favorite} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_list( item_id, user_id, name, category_id, amount, purchase_date ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{purchaseDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.name, i.category_id AS categoryId, i.amount, i.purchase_amount AS purchaseAmount, i.deadline, i.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, i.others, i.status, i.favorite_flg AS favorite, c.name AS categoryName FROM items i INNER JOIN categories c ON i.category_id = c.id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.purchase_date IN ( SELECT DISTINCT purchase_date FROM items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purchase_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY purchase_date DESC LIMIT 3 ) ORDER BY i.purchase_date DESC, i.name ASC
SELECT items.id, items.name, items.deadline, items.user_id AS userId FROM items WHERE items.status <> 0 AND items.deadline <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days' ORDER BY items.user_id
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS count FROM items WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 GROUP BY category_id

SELECT items.id, items.name, items.category_id AS categoryId, items.amount, items.deadline, items.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, items.others, items.status, items.favorite_flg AS favorite, categories.name AS categoryName FROM items INNER JOIN categories ON items.category_id = categories.id WHERE items.status = 1 AND items.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT items.id, items.name, items.category_id AS categoryId, items.amount, items.deadline, items.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, items.others, items.status, items.favorite_flg AS favorite, categories.name AS categoryName FROM items INNER JOIN categories ON items.category_id = categories.id WHERE items.status = 1 AND items.user_id = #{userId} AND items.id IN #{id}

SELECT latest.id, latest.name, latest.category_id AS categoryId, latest.amount, latest.purchase_amount AS purchaseAmount, latest.deadline, latest.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, latest.others, latest.status, latest.favorite_flg AS favorite, categories.name AS categoryName FROM ( SELECT items.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY items.name ORDER BY items.purchase_date DESC NULLS LAST, items.id DESC ) AS row_num FROM items WHERE items.user_id = #{userId} AND items.favorite_flg = true ) latest INNER JOIN categories ON latest.category_id = categories.id WHERE latest.row_num = 1 ORDER BY latest.status ASC, latest.name ASC
